resources.string: Pimp my Phone gestures and overlays

Lets Pimp my Phone draw edge handles, edge lighting and the camera ring, run gesture actions such as back, home and screenshot, and notice which app is open so per-app profiles can apply. If you turn on volume-button track skipping, it also sees volume key presses. Pimp my Phone does not read screen content.
A living sky that follows the time of day and tilts with your phone.
